meta.title: Configurable Invoice Validation Rule Engine: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as an AP Executive on a tenant below Growth and verify the Configurable Invoice Validation Rule Engine is unavailable or refused.
Use the Configurable Invoice Validation Rule Engine to configure validation checks on every invoice.
Repeat the same flow on a Growth tenant and verify that the capability is available.
Compare the capability outcome across tenants with different plan tiers.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as an AP Executive on a tenant below Growth and verify the Configurable Invoice Validation Rule Engine is unavailable or refused.; Use the Configurable Invoice Validation Rule Engine to configure validation checks on every invoice.; Repeat the same flow on a Growth tenant and verify that the capability is available.; Compare the capability outcome across tenants with different plan tiers.

args.need: sign in as an AP Executive on a below-Growth tenant, verify the Configurable Invoice Validation Rule Engine is unavailable or refused, then repeat on a Growth tenant and verify the same capability is available

steps.note: The catalog cannot access invoice validation, authenticate as the AP Executive, or select and compare tenant plan tiers.
Verify the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester completes the unavailable capability check.
